summary: Build a website for the "Bunty Babli" cleaning service.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Wordmark-style logo on transparent background, clean and friendly, with broom/sparkle motif (bunty-babli-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Wide hero banner illustration/photo-style graphic featuring a tidy home/office and cleaning tools, warm and welcoming (cleaning-hero.dim_1600x900.png)
- Set of 4 simple line/flat icons: broom, spray bottle, mop, bucket (cleaning-icons-set.dim_512x512.png)

existing_features.title: Create a responsive marketing website for “Bunty Babli Cleaning Service” with core sections: Hero (headline + short value proposition), Services, Pricing (or “Get a Quote” if pricing is not fixed), About, Service Area/Locations (generic text, no maps), Testimonials, FAQ, and Contact.

Add a contact/inquiry form that collects: full name, phone number, email (optional), service type (select), preferred date (optional), address/area (text), and message; validate required fields client-side and show success/error states.
Wire the frontend contact form to the backend inquiry API using React Query for mutation state and error handling.

Create a coherent, distinctive visual theme for the site (colors, typography, spacing, component style) suitable for a local cleaning service brand, and apply it consistently across all sections. Avoid a blue/purple primary palette.
Add basic SEO and metadata: page title, meta description, and Open Graph tags for the Bunty Babli Cleaning Service homepage.

Generate and include required static images as frontend assets and use them in the UI (do not serve images through the backend). Place generated images under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them from the homepage.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a website for Bunty Babli cleaning service
